correctness.rationale: Independently construct GP(8,3) and even/odd closed-neighborhood generators; exact face counts for radii 0..7 are 16,40,168,976,11028,64444,65534,65535. Global oriented Hasse DAG confirms acyclic matchings, stage3 one 0-cell plus 47 critical 2-cells, stage4 one 0-cell, 41 4-cells and 2 6-cells, stage5 one 0-cell, two 9-cells and five 10-cells. Independent signed Morse reduction gives primitive rank-one matrix [[0,1,-1,0,0],[0,1,-1,0,0]] so degree9 rank1, degree10 rank4 without torsion. Independently 64 exact collapses retract scale2 to scale1 original graph, validating nine H1 bars [1,3). Stage6 boundary S14, stage7 simplex. Each other degree dies before next scale. Full stated integral barcode follows.
